# Table cells with inline markup

A cell's content is markdown, so a code span, a link, an emphasis and an image
inside one are parsed rather than left as characters.

| Surface                        | Where it lives                              |
| ------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------- |
| `kapi up`                      | The [command reference](/docs/reference/cli) |
| **Content memory**             | Beside the *terms* store                     |
| ![the badge](/img/badge.svg)   | The project README                          |
| A cell with `code` and a [link](/docs) and **bold** together | All three at once |

| Alignment | Left | Centre | Right |
| :-------- | :--- | :----: | ----: |
| Row one   | `a`  | *b*    | [c](/d) |

Prose after the tables.
